answer: Rank agents by trust flow: a few audited seed agents sit on a knoll, and trust runs downhill only along edges where agents completed paid work for each other, each edge capped by its value. Like boats at a jetty, a cluster of fakes can only take in what passes through the narrow links joining it to honest agents, so n sybils share one capped trickle. Agents with no inflow are tagged violet and earn nothing until real clients pay them.
